MULTI REFERENCE

Jika menggunakan lebih dari satu gambar referensi:

1. Aktifkan sakelar Multi Reference.
2. Aktifkan hanya gambar yang dipakai.
3. Nonaktifkan gambar yang tidak digunakan.

Disarankan semua foto berasal dari orang yang sama dengan pencahayaan dan sudut wajah yang mirip agar wajah lebih konsisten.

Camera locked on a rigid professional tripod, completely static, fixed position from start to end, never follows the subject, perfectly stable camera, no camera shake, no handheld movement, no micro jitter, no vibration, no tracking, no zoom in, no zoom out, no dolly movement, no camera panning, no camera rotation, no camera tilt, fixed framing, static shot, consistent composition, sharp focus at all times, subject always in focus, no focus breathing, no autofocus hunting, no motion blur, no lens blur, ultra clear details, crisp image quality, smooth natural motion, professional studio camera, stable video capture, high detail, high realism.

The background smoke and volumetric fog are naturally animated throughout the entire video. The smoke continuously drifts, swirls, curls, expands, and softly dissipates with realistic fluid dynamics, creating subtle variations in density and direction. Gentle air currents cause the smoke to flow naturally without becoming chaotic or distracting. The colorful RGB lighting diffuses dynamically through the moving smoke, producing realistic volumetric light rays, soft glowing haze, and continuously changing atmospheric depth. The smoke motion remains smooth, cinematic, and physically believable while the camera stays perfectly static.

OUTPUT HD 1080 × 1920

Cabang ini memperbesar frame akhir menggunakan Lanczos dan mengekspor H.264 MP4 dengan CRF 14.

Output asli tetap tersedia sebagai cadangan. Untuk mode lanskap, ubah Width = 1920 dan Height = 1080.

DOWNLOAD ZIP VIDEO FINAL HD + AUDIO

1. Unggah gambar dan video referensi seperti biasa.
2. Jalankan seluruh workflow. Jika memakai Play/Run pada satu node, pilih node 496 (ZIP), bukan node 490.
3. Unduh MotionFly_1080HD_ZIP_R2...zip melalui Daftar Tugas, lalu ekstrak MP4.
4. Alternatif: klik kanan video pada node 493 dan pilih Save preview selama sesi masih aktif.

Jalur unduhan sama dengan KOH (1): preview sementara 493 (save_output=false) -> VHS_SelectFilename 494 (index=-1) -> CompressImages 496. ZIP membungkus MP4 preview beserta audio tanpa encode ulang.

Node 490 hanya salinan cadangan dan bukan sumber ZIP. Salinan video biasa di Daftar Tugas dapat berbeda dari MP4 di dalam ZIP. Frame final HD, audio, FPS, model, sampler, seed, dan pengaturan generasi asli dipertahankan.
